text:
Maya Chen: Pushed a quick Figma update — trying a denser legend for the spend chart so users can see org vs workspace breakdown without scrolling. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz (frame: spend-dashboard-legend-v2)
CJ Rivera: I like the density but worried about scan time. More items + smaller dots = harder to parse quickly.
Priya (design): Agreed. We could group by scope (Org / Project) with a collapsible header. Keeps density but gives hierarchy.
Alex K: How would collapse state persist per user? We don't have per-user settings for this view yet.
Priya (design): We can persist in localStorage initially. If we later add a user preference endpoint, we switch over.
Maya Chen: Also hearing accessibility nit — current color palette for tokens/lines fails contrast for some label text at smaller sizes.
CJ Rivera: Can you call out which pairs? I can run the contrast checker.
Priya (design): Token colors: teal+light-blue combination is the culprit at 12px labels. Suggest we pick same hue but darker 15% for labels or add bold.
Alex K: If we darken labels, legend markers still need to match series color. Don't want users confused by mismatch.
Maya Chen: Proposal: keep markers as-is, but render label text at 14px semibold and 100% contrast color. That keeps visual parity and improves legibility.
CJ Rivera: Sounds reasonable. Also, on small widths the legend wraps under the chart and pushes content down. Can we make the legend a horizontal scroll container instead?
Priya (design): Horizontal scroll has touch UX benefits on mobile. But desktop keyboard accessibility is tricky. Need focus outlines and aria roles.
Alex K: Implementation wise we can render as overflow-x auto and add tabindex for keyboard nav. I'll add aria-live for dynamic changes.
Maya Chen: Another UX question: when users switch between Org vs Project scope, should we animate the chart or instantly swap? Animation helps continuity but slows perceived performance.
CJ Rivera: For large token datasets animation can add 300-400ms. I'd prefer a quick crossfade rather than full morphing.
Priya (design): Crossfade + subtle loading skeleton for heavy queries.
Maya Chen: Copy tweak — the scope selector currently says "Account / Project" which confused a new PM. Suggest "Organization / Project" to match admin language.
Alex K: Fine by me. Will need i18n key change: ui.scope.org_vs_project -> "Organization / Project"
Maya Chen: Billing export placement: people asked for download invoice CTA in the toolkit header. We have it in a dropdown today. Thoughts?
CJ Rivera: Make it a primary CTA when on invoice view, secondary everywhere else. We should A/B test.
Priya (design): I'll mock both: header button vs dropdown item. Will include focus states and screenreader label: "Download invoice for selected period".
product-bot: Deploy preview for spend-dashboard-legend-v2 deployed to staging at https://staging.redwood.ai/spend?legend=v2 (expires in 3h)
Alex K: I'll pick this up after stand. Assigning myself to implementation and accessibility checklist.
Maya Chen: Thanks — Priya will iterate the mocks. CJ please run contrast checks and post results here.
Priya (design): I'll also add the collapse state microcopy: "Group by: Organization · Project" with a chevron.
CJ Rivera: Contrast report: teal markers need +18% label darkening to hit AA at 12px. POST: https://contrast-checker.app/report/abc
Maya Chen: Awesome. Let's reconvene if anything blocks dev. :thumbsup:
